Third-party libraries (local copies so the app works offline)

  html2pdf.bundle.min.js   html2pdf.js 0.10.1 (MIT)  includes jsPDF + html2canvas
      CDN: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js
  docx.umd.js              docx 8.5.0 (MIT)           builds real .docx files
      CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/docx@8.5.0/build/index.umd.js

To use the CDN versions instead, change the two <script src="vendor/..."> lines in index.html.
The font in js/15-fonts-lmroman.js is Latin Modern Roman 10 (GUST Font License).
